summary: Closing statement: the capitalization fee (capital contribution) becomes configuration on the community's homeowner rate row (community_assessment_rates.capitalization_fee_pct + capitalization_fee_evidence). Seeds the community already configured for builder transfers (migration 500) at 100% of the annual assessment, from its declaration's Capitalization Fee section. No ledger, GL, tenure, ownership or sale row changes.

preflight.name: the configured community has exactly one homeowner rate row
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM community_assessment_rates WHERE community_id = 'a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006' AND owner_class = 'homeowner'
